description:
## v1.2.0 — fixes the "stuck on the welcome splash" bug

Opera Beta (and stable) Play builds download their Chromium engine on first run. When that setup failed on a re-signed (patched) APK, the app sat on the purple welcome splash forever and showed only a black screen afterwards. v1.2.0 fixes this in two layers:

- **Spoof app signature** (new, all three apps): the app now sees Opera's original "Opera Software" signing certificate instead of the Morphe key (PackageInfo.CREATOR parcel proxy, ApkSignatureKillerEx lineage). This removes the certificate-gated failure of the first-run engine download. The official certificate (SHA-256 5d6afbf8…b8) is bundled.
- **Ignore browser boot failures** (new, Opera & Opera Beta): if the first-run engine boot (MainLibraryBoot) still fails, its failure announcements are converted into success notifications so the welcome screen can never deadlock again.
- The bundle is renamed to **Vogelkop patches** and now ships its own source icon (the Vogelkop bowerbird logo).

### Also in this release
- Google Play Protect's "scan the app" prompt on install is expected for every sideloaded APK and is not caused by the patches; see the README.
- Patch sources: added `extensions/` (runtime hook, no-stdlib Kotlin) and `tools/build_extension.sh` (rebuilds `extensions/extension.mpe` without the Android SDK).

### Import
Add as patch source: https://morphe.software/add-source?github=maniesh-NR/Vogelkop-MorphePatches

patches.name: Disable Acceptable Ads whitelist
patches.description: Replaces Opera's hidden partner whitelists (Google/Yandex measurement, Taboola, gambling and shopping affiliates, AppsFlyer/Adjust/Kochava/CJ tracking domains) with empty filter lists, so the built-in ad blocker actually blocks them.

patches.name: Disable ad modules
patches.description: Prevents Opera from loading its bundled third-party ad network modules (Liftoff/Vungle, Mintegral, Pangle/ByteDance) by breaking the reflective class lookup used by the ad mediation layer.

patches.name: Hide broken installation dialog
patches.description: Prevents the "Your app installation appears to be broken. Try to uninstall and reinstall" dialog from blocking startup. The dialog is Opera's crash-recovery nag (it also appears on unmodified installs after a crash or inside app-cloning tools), not a signature check, and its reinstall advice cannot fix a patched build.

patches.name: Ignore browser boot failures
patches.description: Stops a failed first-run engine boot (MainLibraryBoot) from deadlocking the welcome screen. Opera announces boot failures (engine download or Chromium start) to the welcome flow, which used to call the now-hidden "broken installation" dialog and then wait forever. The announcements are converted into success notifications so startup always continues. Pair with "Spoof app signature", which fixes the underlying certificate-gated engine download.

patches.name: Remove sponsored Speed Dial
patches.description: Stops sponsored/partner tiles from appearing on the start page by making Opera's suggested-sites database queries return no rows. Regular Speed Dial entries and bookmarks are not affected.

patches.name: Spoof app signature
patches.description: Makes the app see the original Opera signing certificate after Morphe re-signs it. Opera's first run downloads its Chromium engine (MainLibraryBoot) and re-signed APKs can fail that setup with a foreign certificate, which previously left the app stuck on the welcome splash. Does not bypass Play Integrity hardware attestation.

release_notes:
## What's fixed

**Opera Beta stuck on the purple welcome splash / black screen after restart** — this release fixes it in two layers:

1. **`Spoof app signature`** (new, all three apps) — after Morphe re-signs an APK, Opera's first-run engine download ("MainLibraryBoot": Play builds fetch their Chromium engine at first start) can reject a build that reports a foreign certificate. A tiny extension now presents Opera's original vendor certificate (SHA-256 `5d6afbf8…b8`, extracted from the official `ftp.opera.com` build) to every in-app signature read.
2. **`Ignore browser boot failures`** (new, Opera & Opera Beta) — if the first-run engine boot still fails (e.g. offline first start), its failure announcements are converted into success notifications, so the welcome screen can never deadlock again.

> **About the Play Protect prompt** — the "scan this app" / lockscreen code dialog appears for *every* sideloaded APK signed by an unknown key. It is part of the installer, not of these patches, and cannot be patched away. See the README for details.

## Also in this release

- The bundle is renamed to **Vogelkop patches** (was "Morphe patches for opera" / "Vogelkop Morphe Patches").
- Morphe Manager now shows the **Vogelkop bowerbird logo** as the source icon (a `patches-bundle.png` sits next to `patches-bundle.json` in the repo root).
- All structural fingerprints were re-verified on Opera stable 103.3.5234.91185, Opera Beta 104.0.5262.91143 and Opera GX 3.3.18; full write-up in [`evidence/ANALYSIS.md` §6](https://github.com/maniesh-NR/Vogelkop-MorphePatches/blob/main/evidence/ANALYSIS.md).
- Signing key: unchanged from v1.1.2 (`morphe-signing.pub`, fingerprint `3243 98b0 95c8 b7f4`).

## Install

Add as patch source: https://morphe.software/add-source?github=maniesh-NR/Vogelkop-MorphePatches

## Files

- `patches-1.2.0.mpp` — the patch bundle (contains `classes.dex` + the extension, Ed25519-signed, `MorpheSig1` ZIP comment)
- `SHA256SUMS.txt` — checksums of all release artifacts

> **Supersedes v1.1.1 and older** — v1.1.x did not contain the splash fix. Older releases are kept for reference only; do not install them.
